thread:
mike_support: Heads-up — customer reported our eval CI started failing on tool/function calls. They see a schema validation error in their golden prompt runs, failing the toolcall tests. Job: CI #4821, run started 2026-03-16.
jordan_customer: "I run the sanity evals for our ingestion pipeline and the tool call tests threw: 'InvalidArgument: max_results expected integer, got string' — this started after the latest model update. Repro steps attached." :frowning:
mike_support: Pasting the minimal payload they used (sanitized):\n```json\n{"tool": "search_v2", "args": {"query": "best pizza near me", "max_results": "5"}}\n```\nValidation error: `schema.validate(args) -> TypeError: max_results: expected int`

sophia_eng: thx — quick guess: earlier model output used to return numbers as ints in function args, new model or tokenizer variant is emitting numeric tokens as strings in the toolcall output. Our eval CI validator is strict (jsonschema with type checks). Can confirm this causes failures in the toolcall test harness.
raj_oncall: we saw something similar in staging last month where ambiguous function naming + model variant caused both wrong tool selection and args typed as strings. But this message is strictly about arg typing. CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821 (failing tests: toolcall-schema/args-type)
ci-bot: CI job 4821 summary: 7 failing tests / 120 total. Failing suite: `golden-toolcall-prompts` — assertion: `max_results` type == integer. Full log excerpt: `TypeError: max_results: got \"5\" (str) at validator line 83`.
mike_support: Customer wants a repro/playbook we can run locally to validate. Anyone can triage quickly? We need either a CI hotfix (coercion in test harness) or a model-side prompt fix (golden prompts updated to ensure numeric tokens are emitted as ints).
sophia_eng: Quick repro command (local eval harness):\n```bash\n# run single golden prompt through toolcall runner\npython evals/run_toolcall.py --prompt tests/golden/search_v2/pizza.json --model rdx-open-6b --output tmp.json\n```\nIf you print the toolcall payload right after parse, you'll see "max_results": "5" for the failing model variant.

sophia_eng: Proposed mitigation: update the toolcall validator to accept numeric strings for integer fields in the eval CI only (coerce before assert). But we should not silently coerce in production runtime. Alternative: tighten golden prompts so the model emits numbers as tokens (e.g., include "max_results": 5 in example tool usages in prompt). Prefer short-term CI coercion + long-term golden prompt fixes.
mike_support: Customer reaction: they can patch their prompt but asked for guidance for others. They also want CI to block regressions so this doesn't recur.
lena_sre: avoid changing runtime behavior. Failing open to production coercion could mask model regressions. For CI: add a preprocessing step in the eval harness that normalizes types (coerce numeric strings to ints where schema expects int) and log any coercions as warnings. Also add a regression test that asserts no coercions happened for existing golden prompts (so we detect when a model starts returning strings).
sophia_eng: ok I'll open a PR that: 1) adds a `coercion_log` to the eval runner output, 2) coerce numeric strings -> ints before validation in CI only, and 3) updates 3 affected golden prompts to explicitly show numeric literals in examples. Draft branch: `fix/toolcall-coerce-ci-4821`, commit `a3f9c1d`. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/2345
raj_oncall: can we add a quick smoke in the CI job to run `--strict` mode that fails if coercions were required? That will catch regressions while allowing teams to submit prompt fixes.
sophia_eng: yep will add `--strict` flag toggle. Default CI run will be permissive for now with coercion and warning; nightly `--strict` job will enforce zero coercions until golden prompts are fixed.
mike_support: ETA for the PR? Customer wants an ETA and a recommended short-term workaround.
sophia_eng: ETA EOD today for PR + patch to CI. Short-term workaround for customers: explicitly include a one-line example in their prompt showing "max_results": 5 (no quotes) or use the post-processing step to cast numeric strings to ints when calling the tool.
mike_support: thanks everyone — I'll update the customer with the PR link and recommended prompt snippet. Will follow up if they still see failures.
ci-bot: linked job: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821/logs — failing test cases: `search_v2:limit-coerce-test`, `search_v2:golden-pizza`.
lena_sre: also file an internal ticket to monitor model rollout that triggered this. Tagging: @sophia_eng @raj_oncall to follow up with model team.
mike_support: noted. Closing loop when PR merges. :+1:
